text: Technical teams retain full visibility and control over guardrails, integrations, and versioning of the agent
quote: technical teams retain full visibility and control over guardrails, integrations, and versioning

text: Agents use short-lived, scoped JWT tokens for real-time system access, discarded after each session
quote: Short-lived JWT tokens give AI agents real-time access to customer systems, scoped for minimal privilege and discarded after each session.

text: A purpose-built infrastructure layer curates, scopes, and evaluates how the agent's tools are actually used
quote: Bridging that gap requires an infrastructure layer purpose-built to curate, scope, and evaluate how tools are actually used.

text: Browser Actions let the agent log in, navigate, and complete tasks inside any system via computer use
quote: Browser Actions gives your agent a way through computer use. It extends the agent you've already built so it can log in, navigate, and complete a task inside any system your team can access.

text: Non-technical teams can define and adjust agent behavior in natural language, similar to writing human-agent SOPs
quote: you can define agent behavior in natural language, the same way you train human agents with SOPs

text: Past customer interactions are analyzed to auto-generate Agent Operating Procedures based on real customer needs
quote: Analyze past customer interactions to automatically generate Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) rooted in actual customer needs.

text: Run controlled experiments by defining a variable and traffic split, measured against a control group in production
quote: Define your variable and traffic split, then measure results against a stable control group directly in production.

text: Watchtower lets you define flagging criteria in natural language (e.g. frustration, policy violations) and applies it contextually
quote: Define what matters using natural language. From "mentions of frustration" to "violations of data privacy policy," Watchtower understands your flagging criteria and applies your intent contextually.

text: Ask open-ended natural-language questions like 'why are customers requesting refunds?' to instantly analyze conversations
quote: Ask open-ended questions like “Why are customers requesting refunds?” to instantly analyze customer conversations.

text: Automatically detects knowledge gaps and drafts help-center content based on how top human agents resolved similar issues
quote: It automatically detects knowledge gaps and generates content drafts based on how your best human agents resolved those same issues, so your help center stays ahead of customer needs.

text: Duet can auto-generate tests covering diverse conversation paths to verify accuracy, policy adherence, and brand tone
quote: Use Duet to easily generate tests covering diverse pathways that verify whether agents respond accurately, follow policies, and reflect your brand.

text: Chat agent works across web, mobile, and messaging platforms with on-brand styling
quote: Flexible, on-brand chat built for conversations across web, mobile, and messaging platforms.

text: Voice AI agents handle natural, multilingual phone conversations customized to brand voice
quote: Voice AI agents built for natural, multilingual conversations and customized to your brand.

text: Email agent understands context, stays on brand, and manages complex multi-message customer threads
quote: Intelligent email that understands context, stays on brand, and handles complex customer threads.

text: Customizable visual heatmaps make it easy to spot spikes or dips in key support metrics
quote: Customizable visual heatmaps... Quickly identify spikes or dips in key metrics.

text: Integrates with identity providers like Okta and Microsoft Entra for secure, passwordless access across systems
quote: Decagon integrates with identity providers like Okta and Microsoft Entra, enabling secure access across systems without additional passwords.

text: Agent carries conversation history across sessions and proactively recommends actions based on customer signals
quote: Carry conversation history across sessions to pick up where you left off and make proactive recommendations based on customer signals.

text: Can initiate proactive, on-brand outbound calls timed to key moments in the customer journey
quote: Initiate intelligent, on-brand calls that reliably reach customers at the right moments throughout their journey.
